title: Hako
description: Hako is a simple, taggable modern bulletin board platform designed to foster open, dynamic, and inclusive interactions. Users can effortlessly create and participate in discussion threads, post comments, and share ideas either anonymously or with optional pseudonyms, requiring no account registration for seamless access.
description2: Beyond discussions, Hako serves as a versatile space where users can share their creative writings, such as stories, poems, or essays, and even keep personal diaries. The platform’s minimalist design and intuitive interface encourage authentic expression, allowing users to connect, reflect, and inspire one another in a vibrant, community-driven environment.
description3: Before posting, please ensure you have read our {rule_link}. Please also check our {faq_link} for common questions.
rule_description: By using this site, you agree to abide by our community guidelines to ensure a respectful and safe environment for all users.
rule_intro: To keep Hako enjoyable for everyone, please follow these guidelines:
rule_1: Be respectful. No harassment, hate speech, or discrimination.
rule_2: Stay on-topic. Avoid spamming or derailing discussions.
rule_3: No illegal, harmful, or explicit content. [b]NSFW content is strictly prohibited![/b]
rule_4: Use clear and concise titles when creating threads.
rule_5: Report inappropriate posts instead of engaging.
rule_outro: Breaking these rules may result in warnings or bans. Thank you for helping us keep the community safe.
faq_description: Find answers to common questions about using Hako.
faq_g_a1: Hako is a simple, taggable bulletin board where you can create and join discussions.
faq_g_a2: You are free to post almost anything! Whether it's questions, stories, personal thoughts, or even your own creative works, this website is a versatile platform for sharing and engaging with a wide range of topics. Posts are organised under tags that users choose based on the topic of their content, making it easier for others to discover and engage with. Even so, please ensure your posts comply with our {rule_link}. We do not suggest posting any illegal, harmful, or explicit content.
faq_g_a3: All posts are publicly visible to anyone visiting the site. However, you can choose to post anonymously or use a pseudonym to protect your identity.
faq_p_q1: Do I need an account to post?
faq_p_a1: No, you can post without the need for an account. By default, you will be posting anonymously, but you can choose to use a pseudonym if you wish.
faq_p_q2: How do I start posting threads?
faq_p_a2:
To create a new thread, go to the homepage and look for the [b]Create a New Thread[/b] section.

You will need to fill out the following fields:
[list][*][b]Subject[/b] – A clear and concise title for your thread.[*][b]Content[/b] – The main body of your post.[*][b]Tags[/b] – Keywords that best describe your topic.[*][b]Language[/b] – Select the language of your post.[*][b]File (optional)[/b] – Upload an image (JPG, PNG, or WebP, up to 2MB).[/list]
After completing the fields, you must pass a CAPTCHA to verify you are a human.
Finally, click [b]Post Thread[/b] to submit.

If successful, a confirmation message will appear. If there are errors, please review the messages shown, correct them, and try again.
faq_p_q3: What are tags and how do I use them?
faq_p_a3:
Tags are keywords that help categorize your thread and make it easier for others to find. When creating a thread, you can enter multiple tags that are relevant to your topic. For example, if you're posting about a programming question, you might use tags like [i]programming[/i], [i]coding[/i], or [i]javascript[/i].

Choose tags that accurately reflect the content of your thread to improve visibility and engagement from users interested in those topics.
faq_p_q4: How can I input tags in a thread creation?
faq_p_a4: When creating a thread, you can input tags in the [b]Tags[/b] field. Simply type the desired tag and press [b]Enter[/b] or [b]Comma (,)[/b] to add it. You can add multiple tags by repeating this process. Make sure to choose tags that are relevant to your thread's content to help others find it more easily.
faq_p_q5: How do I reply to threads?
faq_p_a5:
To reply to a thread, open the thread you want to respond to. Scroll down to the [b]Post a Reply[/b] section. You can optionally select a specific reply to respond by clicking the reply icon on the thread you want to reply. This lets you respond to a reply within the main thread.

After selecting a thread to respond, fill in your content and complete the CAPTCHA, then click [b]Post Reply[/b].

 [b]Note:[/b] [list][*]You must provide either content or a file when posting a reply.[*]By default, replies are directed to the main thread unless you respond to a specific post.[/list]
faq_p_q6: How can I delete or edit my posts?
faq_p_a6: Currently, there is no option to delete or edit posts once they are submitted. Please ensure that you review your content before posting.
faq_p_q7: How do I report inappropriate content?
faq_p_a7:
If you come across a thread that you believe violates our community guidelines, you can report it by clicking the red flag icon located at the top right of the thread page. This will open a dialog where you can provide a reason for your report.

Once you submit the report, it will be reviewed by our moderators. You will receive a confirmation message indicating that your report has been successfully submitted. If there is an issue with the submission, an error message will be displayed, and you can try again later.
faq_p_q8: What is CAPTCHA and why do I need to complete it?
faq_p_a8:
[url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CAPTCHA]CAPTCHA[/url] is a security measure to prevent spam and automated posts. It helps ensure that only real users can post content. You will need to complete a CAPTCHA challenge each time you create a new thread or post a reply.

If you find the CAPTCHA difficult, you can refresh it to get a new challenge.

Please note that there is a cooldown period between CAPTCHA submissions to prevent abuse. If you encounter an error while submitting the CAPTCHA, please wait for the cooldown period to end before trying again.

The cooldown period usually lasts for one minute. CAPTCHA regeneration starts with a 5-second cooldown, and each subsequent attempt follows the Fibonacci sequence (5s, 5s, 10s, 15s, 25s, and so on).
